title: Digital Learning Systems Analyst
description: Employer-posting summary for testing, not the complete listing. UCF Center for Distributed Learning seeks an analyst connecting business stakeholders with development teams. Responsibilities cover requirements gathering, portfolio intake and prioritization, functional requirements, process documentation, technical specifications, workflow analysis, change management, training, application implementation, testing, upgrades, releases, troubleshooting and post-implementation support. The role references Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Excel, Access and Apache Superset. Preferred qualifications include enterprise or digital-learning application support, applied programming, functional testing, issue tracking, system change documentation, stakeholder communication, and familiarity with FERPA, ADA, WCAG and LTI. The posting requires qualifying education or equivalent experience, a digital portfolio, on-site work in Orlando, and authorization to work without employer visa sponsorship. Verify the complete employer posting before applying.
